trends.source: The imported GitHub dataset lists the World Economic Forum Future of Jobs Report 2025. It does not specify the exact table or page for each category.
limitations: Historical labels are qualitative, not annual job counts.
Future labels are scenario assumptions, not a validated forecast.
The listed source requires citation-level review before external claims.

categories.impact: More demand for AI and data skills
Routine coding changes; system skills grow
More care demand and AI-assisted tasks
Lower demand for repetitive clerical tasks

scenarios.warning: Illustrative rule-based outputs only. The coefficients and 68.9% starting value are assumptions from the imported prototype, not calibrated or validated labour data.

mappings.target_summary: Increase the number of youth and adults with relevant skills, including technical and vocational skills, for employment and decent jobs.
mappings.relevance_reason: The Data Analyst pathway links role-related skills to guided practice activities. That is a potential connection to Target 4.4's focus on relevant skills for employment.
supporting_evidence: Illustrative pathway requirement: SQL (self-rating target 4/5).
Practice activity: Answer five realistic questions with SQL.
Illustrative pathway requirement: Pandas (self-rating target 3/5).
Practice activity: Prepare and explain a cleaned dataset.
Illustrative pathway requirement: Data Visualisation (self-rating target 3/5).
Practice activity: Build three charts and explain each insight.
mappings.user_action: Rate your SQL, Pandas, and data-visualisation skills in the reskilling pathway, then complete the practice project for each gap.
mappings.impact_limitations: Potential alignment only. FutureSkill pathway skill requirements and practice activities are illustrative, not independently validated. This mapping does not establish employment, decent working conditions, fair access, or measurable progress on an SDG indicator.

mappings.target_summary: Promote full and productive employment and decent work for all, including young people and persons with disabilities.
mappings.relevance_reason: The Data Analyst pathway helps a learner practise skills associated with a potential occupation. This is a preparation link to Target 8.5, not evidence that the learner will obtain decent work.
